name: EV-H2 Block lost card and send SMS confirmation
description: Happy path: lost card is blocked after verification, replacement ordered, SMS confirmation sent. Customer: Ava Thompson (CUST-1001), physical card ending 4821.

instructions.conversation_prompt: Identity was verified before any card action. The card ending 4821 was blocked via the fraud-block-card tool (not merely claimed), a replacement with an ETA was communicated, and an SMS confirmation with the card_blocked template was sent. The agent only ever referenced the last 4 digits of the card, never a full card number.

turns.user_message: Help — I lost my credit card somewhere at the airport. I need to block it right now.
turns.expected_output: Brief latency filler lines like 'Let me pull up your account details' or 'One moment' are platform announcements, NOT account-data disclosures — ignore them. Agent responds with urgency/empathy to the declined-card concern and moves to identity verification before disclosing any account information or card status. Fail ONLY on actual pre-verification disclosure of account data or an account action.
turns.reference_response: I'm sorry to hear that — I can block it right away. First, let me verify you quickly: what's the phone number on your account?

turns.expected_output: Agent asks for the verification PIN.
turns.reference_response: Thank you. And your 4-digit verification PIN?

turns.expected_output: After verification the agent secures the card: EITHER the fraud-block-card tool is called this turn, OR the agent clearly states it is blocking the card right now (block-in-progress). Asking about a replacement card in the same breath is acceptable. Choosing the physical card without asking is acceptable (the declined-at-store context implies it). Fail only if the agent neither blocks nor commits to blocking, or wanders to another topic.
turns.reference_response: You're verified, Ava. Just to confirm — is it your physical card ending 4821, or your virtual card?

turns.user_message: Yes, the physical one ending 4821. And please send me a replacement.
turns.expected_output: Agent calls fraud-block-card for the card ending 4821 with reason lost (or stolen), confirms the block and the replacement timeline, AND sends the SMS confirmation (calls send-sms-confirmation with the card_blocked template) or clearly states a confirmation text was sent.
turns.reference_response: Done — your card ending 4821 is blocked, and a replacement is on the way in 5 to 7 business days. I've just texted you a confirmation.

agent_notes: Phone matched a Meridian customer. Ask for the 4-digit verification PIN.
Never read the PIN back to the caller.
Identity verified for Ava. Proceed with the customer's request.
Verification persists for the rest of the session, including across skill switches.

mock_output.message: Customer has more than one active card.
agent_notes: Ava has two active cards: a physical card ending 4821 and a virtual card ending 5578.
Ask which card to block, then call fraud-block-card again with card_last4.
Card ending 4821 is now blocked and a replacement is ordered (5-7 business days).
Send the card_blocked SMS confirmation via send-sms-confirmation.
SMS confirmation sent to the customer's phone on file.
No caller ID is available. Ask the customer for the phone number on their account, then call verify-identity again with it.
